jobs.title: HR Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

The HR Compliance Analyst supports Related’s HR Compliance function across a multi-state workforce, helping ensure our policies, practices, and processes adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards and proactively identify and mitigate compliance risks. The role sits at the intersection of HR and Legal, with hands-on exposure to employment law, litigation support, background screening, and immigration compliance. This position is full-time, reports to the HR Compliance Manager, and will be based in our New York office three days a week. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Regulatory & Policy Compliance

* Monitor new and existing federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and summarize key changes and their impact for the team.
* Maintain compliance calendar and tracker (e.g., statutory deadlines and effective dates).
* Gather data and ensure accuracy for regulatory reports.
* Oversee labor law poster process (e.g., ordering posters, coordinating with business stakeholders, and processing invoices).
* Coordinate OSHA and workers’ compensation poster process with internal stakeholders.
* Support policy and handbook review, updates, and rollout, including state-specific supplements and translations.
* Draft guidance memos for internal stakeholders on new and changing state and local requirements
* Assist with vetting and onboarding third party vendors.
* Monitor and track third party vendor and outside counsel invoices against budgets.
* Support background check compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including preparing fair chance notices within required timelines.
* Assist with the development of clear and engaging training content on evolving regulations and policy refreshers for internal stakeholders.
* Provide general support for compliance-specific projects (e.g., self-audits, tracking deadlines and responses, organizing meetings, and initiating follow up).

Employee Agreements & Employment Litigation

* Prepare, distribute, and track litigation hold notices, acknowledgments, and releases.
* Draft severance agreements and separation letters using approved templates.
* Track severance and settlement payment deadlines, including signatures and revocation periods, and coordinate with Payroll.
* Pull and prepare employee files in response to subpoenas, agency requests, and employee requests to inspect personnel records.
* Gather documents and information to support responses to agency charges (e.g., EEOC and state and local human rights agencies) and pending litigation.

Immigration & Work Authorization

* Partner with HR Operations/Talent Acquisition teams on Form I-9, E-Verify, and visa-related work authorization compliance processes.
* Monitor and track regulatory changes affecting visa holders.
* Track visa and work authorization expiration dates for employer-sponsored visas.
* Assist with self-audits for I-9/visa paperwork.
* Coordinate I-9/visa training with immigration counsel and internal stakeholders.

**Compensation**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. In addition to a competitive base salary, you will be eligible to receive discretionary bonus incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

Anticipated base salary range: $80,000 - $100,000

Actual base salary within the anticipated range will be determined by several components including, but not limited to, the individual's experience, skills, qualifications, and market factors.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 1-3 years of relevant experience in HR, Compliance, or a related field involving a similar skill set.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and shift direction easily.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, accurate memos, notices, and correspondence.
* Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work across all levels within the organization.
* Professional, diplomatic, and comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Self-starter, resourceful, and able to work independently and collaboratively.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; experience with an HRIS (e.g., UKG) a plus.
* Comfort using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to draft, research, and streamline work, paired with the judgment to verify outputs.
* Familiarity with multi-state employment law, background check requirements, severance agreements, or immigration compliance a plus.

Overview:

Formed in 1972, Related is the most prominent privately owned real estate firm in the United States. Headquartered in New York City, the company has offices and major developments across the world. Related owns and manages a premier portfolio of assets valued at over $100 billion, including the 28-acre Hudson Yards neighborhood on Manhattan’s West Side.

Related believes in investing in its talent and cultivates a positive, team-oriented environment where every voice is valued. Employees are encouraged to boldly take on new challenges, transcend the status quo, and demonstrate strong entrepreneurial spirit. In its relentless commitment to excellence, Related works to foster an innovative approach in its team members so that they can positively impact the communities in which they conduct business. Learn more about Related at www.related.com.

jobs.title: Cataloging/Metadata Analyst
jobs.description:
Cataloging/Metadata Analyst

**Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume):**  
Master’s degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Three (3) years of full-time relevant professional experience. Experience in metadata creation, original cataloging, metadata management, or related content services work in an academic library, research library, archives, or comparable cultural heritage organization. Experience working with library/archives management systems, digital repository platforms, or related technologies.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Experience with Alma (Library Management System) and OCLC Connexion. Knowledge of archival/library standards including DACS, EAD, MODS, MARC21, Dublin Core, authority control and controlled vocabularies. Demonstrated interest in leveraging emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI). Participation in/contributions to the cataloging and metadata communities (national/international). Experience working with diverse formats and subject areas. Experience in creating authority records.  
  
**Brief Description of Duties:**  
The Cataloging/Metadata Analyst supports the acquisition, description, discovery, preservation, and accessibility of the Libraries' rare books, manuscripts, and other distinctive collections. Reporting to the Director of Special Collections and University Archives, the position contributes to archival processing, cataloging, metadata creation, public services, and departmental operations. Through high-quality archival practices and user-centered services, the Cataloging/Metadata Analyst enhances the discovery, preservation, and use of Special Collections materials.  
  
The incumbent must demonstrate the ability to learn new technologies, adapt to evolving archival and metadata standards, and work effectively in a collaborative environment with researchers, students, faculty, staff, and community members.

* Cataloging, Metadata & Archival Description:

  + Create, edit, and maintain original and enhanced catalog records (original and copy cataloging plus related authority work), archival descriptions, and metadata for rare books, manuscripts, university archives, audiovisual materials, photographs, maps, and digital collections.
  + Apply national and international cataloging, metadata, and archival description standards to ensure accurate discovery, long-term preservation, and access. Utilize AI-assisted tools, when appropriate, to enhance metadata creation, description, quality assurance, and workflow efficiency while ensuring professional review and adherence to archival/library standards.
* Archival Processing, Collections Management & Preservation

  + Arrange, describe, preserve, and rehouse archival collections in accordance with archival best practices. Prepare, maintain, and update finding aids to support collection discovery and accessibility. Perform the physical retrieval, transport, shelving, and re-shelving of archival and special collections materials. Collaborate with library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, interlibrary loan, and collection access initiatives to support the stewardship and accessibility of collections.
* Reference, Research & Public Services

  + Provide reference and research assistance to faculty, students, university administrators, community members, and visiting scholars through in-person, virtual, telephone, and email communications, including the identification, retrieval, and interpretation of archival and special collections materials. Supervise Special Collections reading rooms.
* Outreach, Instruction & Collection Engagement

  + Support public programming that promotes awareness and use of Special Collections and University Archives including participation in exhibitions, tours, class visits, instructional sessions, and community outreach activities.
* Student/Intern Supervision & Departmental Operations

  + Recruitment, training, supervision and evaluation of student assistants and interns; departmental operational support. Collaboration with other library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, ILL and collection-access initiatives; participation in cross-departmental collection projects.
* Assessment, Professional Development & Service

  + Collect and analyze departmental data for contribution to strategic planning, assessment, reporting, and documentation that supports departmental priorities and continuous improvement.
* Other duties or projects as assigned as appropriate to rank and department mission.

**Special Notes:**  
This is a full-time appointment. FLSA Exempt position, not eligible for the overtime provisions of the FLSA. Minimum salary threshold must be met to maintain FLSA exemption.  
  
In addition to the employee's base salary, this position is eligible for $4,000 UUP annual location pay, paid biweekly.  
  
For this position, we are unable to sponsor candidates for work visas.  
  
**Essential Position:** This has been designated as an essential position based on the duties of the job and the functions performed. Positions that are designated as such may be required to report to work/remain at work even if classes are canceled, and the campus is working on limited operations in an emergency.  
  
Resume/CV and cover letter should be included with the online application.  
  
***Stony Brook University is committed to excellence in diversity and the creation of an inclusive learning and working environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, pregnancy, familial status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status and all other protected classes under federal or state laws.***  
  
If you need a disability-related accommodation, please call the university Office of Equity and Access (OEA) at (631) 632-6280 or visit OEA.

jobs.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Metergy Solutions, LLC. (“Metergy”)**

Metergy has the energy, rapid growth and excitement of a startup, together with a rock-solid, recession-proof business that has a 45 year track record. We’re a technology company that drives huge carbon emission reductions. This is a once-in-a-career opportunity.

As one of North America’s most experienced submetering providers, Metergy has brought turnkey solutions to clients for over 45 years. Metergy supplies, installs and remotely reads meters to measure individual suite consumption of electricity, water, gas, and thermal energy in multi-residential and commercial buildings, and bills and collects for the cost of commodities and administrative charges for the services provided. The business model allows for long-term recurring revenue through an innovative Submetering as a Service (SaaS) model. Submetering is proven to reduce in-suite energy consumption by 40%, driving decarbonization efforts for Metergy’s clients. This performance has enabled Metergy to issue green bonds and obtain green financing.

Positioned as the #1 submeter provider in the New York and Canadian markets, and one of the largest in North America, Metergy has more than 900,000 contracted meters, issues over 4M utility bills annually and has over 500 team members. Metergy is a portfolio company of Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Brookfield is one of the world’s largest investors, owners and operators of infrastructure assets across the utilities, transport, energy, data and sustainable resources sectors. This sponsorship provides Metergy with access to large-scale capital, infrastructure investment expertise and global reach.

**Our Mission**

Provide building owners and occupants with accurate and reliable utility consumption data through market-leading expertise in turnkey submetering and billing, while fostering a workplace with inspired team members empowered to do more good.

At Metergy, we don’t just believe in our people; we champion them. When individuals feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow, incredible things happen. That’s why we’re thrilled to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work** for the **third** **consecutive year**! This achievement reflects our unwavering commitment to building a workplace that’s respectful, inclusive, and high-performing.

Come be part of a team that leads with **passion**, thrives on **positivity**, and delivers with **precision**. We’re proud of who we are and even prouder of where we’re headed.

**The Opportunity:**

The Business Intelligence Analyst will support the Strategy and Analytics team with the execution of detailed analysis and creation of reports, dashboards and visualizations that provide the business with critical information to make informed decisions. The individual will use various tools and techniques to identify trends, patterns, and insights, working with data from various sources, ensuring data quality and integrity, and collaborating with various groups and stakeholders across the business to understand information requirements as well as maintain data integrity/perform audits in our data platform.

Utilize business intelligence and reporting software, database tools, Microsoft Excel, and Office automation to design, build, assess, maintain, improve, and distribute dashboards and reports, combine data, and present accurate information.

  

### **Responsibilities**

* Distill complex data and relationships into clear, concise charts and visualizations, support ad hoc data requests and analysis.

* Design data models to extract data from operational databases and transform the data to easily understood business views.

* Gather and process raw data at scale (including writing scripts, web scraping, calling API’s, writing SQL queries, etc.)

* Process unstructured data into a form suitable for analysis- then do the analysis.

* Automate manual processes.

* Navigate CRM and other systems to build reporting, ensure consistency and compliance across the departments.

* Develop management monthly KPI’s/reports and BI dashboards for stakeholders across all business functions: technology, operations, field, billing etc

* Perform in-depth analysis to identify key business risks and opportunities and make recommendations to improve overall profitability

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Comp Sci/ MIS/ Data Analytics/ Math or Statistics (or any analytical/data driven discipline)

* 0-2 years of experience working within business intelligence (Co-op/Internships included)

* High Proficiency in data modelling and analysis with demonstrated acumen using the following tools Excel, PowerBI, Python & SQL

* Strong SQL experience is a must with knowledge of relational databases, and ability to build and maintain views

* Meticulous attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

* Data driven analytical skills, knowledge and/or experience related to financial analysis

* Excellent problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to addressing challenges

* Ability to prioritize and adapt to changing demands and deadlines, are essential

* Ability to conduct basic statistical and correlation analysis to identify patterns and trends.

* Excellent skills in Excel, R/Python, SQL

* Experienced with BI Tools such as Power BI / Tableau / SAP (Power BI Preferred)

* Creativity, relationship building skills and dedication are all highly desirable

Range reflects base salary and will be dependent on experience. In addition, Metergy offers an annual bonus and other benefits.

**Benefits & Perks**

* Excellent health coverage and life insurance benefits – no waiting period!

* Company-paid Long-Term Disability and Basic Life Coverage

* Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options

* 401K plan with immediate company match

* Generous Paid Time Off Plan plus 10 paid holidays

* Summer hours to enjoy the weather

* Regular Social events - happy hours, summer & holiday parties, & more

jobs.title: Business Application Analyst
jobs.description:
Description:

**About Bankwell:**

Bankwell is a commercial bank with more than $3 billion in assets that serves the banking needs of businesses and individuals. At Bankwell, we pride ourselves on our unique ability to bring you high touch, high quality banking with the expertise and dedication of our experienced team of professionals. When it comes to business, our deep industry knowledge, flexibility and innovative treasury and financing services enable us to find the right solutions for our business and commercial clients. We’re passionate about giving back and are actively involved with many not-for-profit organizations that help shape and improve the lives of others. We’re dedicated to giving our time and talent to support the communities we serve. More about Bankwell can be found at www.mybankwell.com.

**Summary of Position:**

Bankwell is seeking a Business Application Analyst to support and expand the use of Jack Henry Enterprise Workflow (EWF) across the organization. This role serves as the liaison between business departments and technology teams, helping automate, standardize, and improve operational processes through workflow design, system integration, task automation, approvals, and reporting.

The successful candidate will work closely with department leaders and subject matter experts to understand existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, configure workflow solutions, support production workflows, and ensure workflows operate efficiently and consistently throughout the bank.

Enterprise Workflow is a configurable workflow platform that automates business processes through task management, approvals, notifications, document generation, audit tracking, and integration with Jack Henry and third-party applications. It is used across lending, deposits, treasury, operations, compliance, customer service, and human resources.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Workflow Design and Automation**

* Develop workflow routing rules, approval paths, notifications, escalations, and task assignments.
* Modify existing workflows as operational and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Leverage pre-built workflow templates and customize solutions to meet Bankwell requirements.

**Application Support**

* Provide day-to-day support for Enterprise Workflow users.
* Troubleshoot workflow issues, failed transactions, routing problems, and integration errors.
* Monitor workflow performance and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Coordinate with Jack Henry support and third-party vendors when necessary.
* Participate in software upgrades, release testing, and functionality reviews.

**Business Process Improvement**

* Work with business units to document current-state and future-state processes.
* Recommend workflow enhancements that improve consistency, efficiency, accountability, and customer experience.
* Assist departments in adopting workflow automation and best practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across banking operations.

**Workflow Administration**

* Maintain workflow configurations, queues, user assignments, business rules, and approval matrices.
* Support task assignment and workload routing across departments.
* Configure escalation rules, notifications, service-level tracking, and approval structures.
* Ensure workflows align with internal policies and operational controls.

**Integration and Data Management**

* Support integrations between Enterprise Workflow, Jack Henry applications, and other bank systems.
* Assist with workflow-triggered updates to customer records and bank applications.
* Validate workflow-related data exchange and automated maintenance functions.
* Support document generation, electronic communications, and workflow-based data updates.

**Reporting and Audit Support**

* Develop workflow reports and dashboards.
* Monitor workflow metrics, turnaround times, bottlenecks, and exception processing.
* Support auditors and compliance personnel by providing workflow history and audit documentation.
* Ensure workflow solutions maintain appropriate audit trails and process transparency.

Requirements:

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, Operations, or equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of banking operations, business system support, workflow automation, or application support experience.
* Strong understanding of banking processes and operational procedures.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into system solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience documenting business processes and procedures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Jack Henry solutions including SilverLake, Xperience, jXchange, Enterprise Workflow, Banno, or related applications.
* Experience supporting banking operations, lending, deposit operations, treasury management, or compliance functions.
* Workflow automation or business process management (BPM) experience.
* Experience with reporting and data analysis.
* Familiarity with SQL, APIs, integrations, or low-code workflow platforms.
* Understanding of banking regulatory and audit requirements.

**Desired Characteristics**

**Successful candidates will demonstrate:**

* Strong collaboration skills with business subject matter experts.
* Ability to understand operational challenges and design practical workflow solutions.
* Strong ownership and follow-through.
* Curiosity and continuous improvement mindset.
* Ability to balance technical configuration with business process design.
* Comfort working across multiple departments simultaneously.

**FLSA Status: Exempt**

**Competitive compensation and benefits, including:**

* Medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Employer-paid life and disability insurance
* HSA option
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

jobs.title: Analyst, Financial Asset Management
jobs.description:
The Analyst of Financial Asset Management is responsible for supporting day‑to‑day financial execution for the regional portfolio. This role focuses on portfolio maintenance, preparation of Investment Committee materials, and analytical support for asset management and transaction initiatives. The Analyst works closely with the Region Manager and Vice President, as well as the broader regional teams, to ensure financial models, reports, and materials are accurate, timely, and consistent, forming the foundation for effective regional decision‑making.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Portfolio Maintenance & Financial Data Management**

* Maintain asset‑level financial models used for forecasting, planning, and reporting
* Update models for leasing activity, capital expenditures, budget changes, and other asset‑level events
* Coordinate with property management and leasing teams to gather required inputs
* Perform routine data checks and reconciliations to identify errors, inconsistencies, or missing inputs

**IC Preparation & Support**

* Support preparation and updating of IC materials for the regional portfolio
* Populate models, tables, exhibits, and supporting analyses used in IC submissions
* Ensure IC materials are consistent with underlying models
* Incorporate feedback from the Manager accurately and efficiently

**Asset Management Project Support**

* Provide analytical support for approved asset management initiatives and projects
* Prepare ad‑hoc analyses and exhibits to support leasing, capital planning, and operational decisions

**Transaction Support**

* Support Transaction underwriting and diligence processes
* Develop asset-level Argus models for potential acquisition and disposition opportunities
* Refine acquisition underwriting models for transition into the Argus Financial Asset Management environment

**Reporting & Ongoing Analysis**

* Prepare recurring financial reports and summaries for regional and executive use
* Coordinate with Property Management to produce analyses that estimate recovery impact on incremental spend
* Be responsive to regional requests for ad hoc financial analysis

**Team & Process Support**

* Support Manager‑led workflows and recurring processes
* Build and leverage AI and PowerBI tools to improve team efficiency and decision-making
* Identify data gaps or process inefficiencies and raise them to the Manager

**Success Looks Like**

* Financial models and materials that are consistently accurate and well‑maintained
* IC analyses that require minimal rework at the Manager level
* Timely completion of recurring and ad‑hoc requests
* Strong attention to detail and responsiveness to feedback
* Dependable execution that enables Managers and Directors to operate efficiently

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required – finance, real estate, business, or economics major preferred
* Entry-level to one year of analyst experience
* Exposure to ARGUS preferred but not required
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word
* Ability to multi-task and work well in a team-focused environment
* Excellent communication and organizational skills
* Professional approach and demeanor

The base salary range for this position has been established as $75,000-$85,000 PLUS participation in our annual cash bonus plan. This salary range represents the Company’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting.

Brixmor offers a hybrid work schedule (first three days of the week in the office, the balance remote optional), very competitive pay commensurate with background and responsibilities plus a benefits and perks package that supports career engagement, growth, good health and connection with teammates and our communities.

**Job Title:** Senior Analyst, Plan to Forecast
  
  
**Job Requisition ID:** 2371
  
  
**Posting Start Date:** 10/15/26
  
  
At Daiichi Sankyo, we are united by a single purpose, to improve lives around the world through innovative medicines. With a legacy of innovation since 1899, a presence in more than 30 countries, and more than 19,000 employees, we are advancing breakthrough therapies in oncology, cardiovascular disease, rare diseases, and immune disorders. Guided by our 2030 vision to "be an innovative global healthcare company contributing to the sustainable development of society", we are shaping a healthier, more hopeful future for patients, their families, and society.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
This position is part of a team responsible for the end-to-end Plan-to-Forecast (P2F) and Reporting processes. This role will support the Financial Reporting/Planning team, applying in depth system, financial process, and master data knowledge. This also requires demonstrated expertise regarding integration of the solution with SAP and other systems within the Finance landscape. This role will support users of the planning tool ensuring positive user experience. The role ensures that the solution is operating with strong controls, data validation procedures, and security. This position requires the ability to apply independent judgment and critical thinking skills to address difficult issues while meeting deadlines. The role will receive and address escalated or complex questions and issues and escalate further where necessary and as appropriate to bring to timely resolution.
  
  
Responsibilities

Provide support for the regional GBS USSC scope of the relevant end-to-end P2F process and in-scope reporting services
  
  
Support the regional process to develop and manage the annual, long range, and periodic forecasts. Prepare and manage the regional forecast plan; collaborate with contributors to ensure timely completion of milestones; support users in creating reports, maintaining templates, and uploading data
  
  
Analyze and constantly monitor cost structures, cost types and cost centers; gather data and measures for accurate budgeting and cost management including charges; ensure adherence to budgetary, forecasting and transfer pricing guidelines etc. Identify discrepancies in costs, proactively derive, align and implement measures to ensure an exhaustive, timely and fully compliant P2F service process according to agreed activity splits. Ensure a robust validation and reconciliation of data as well as full accuracy, correctness and timeliness of all reports in the scope of the regional GBS. Ensure data accuracy and leverage data analytics tools where applicable in the regional scope of GBS. Role will also assist in validating the transfer of data between systems

Troubleshoot and resolve daily user support tickets and errors in Plan to Forecast area. Make recommendations for preventing issues in the future by analyzing root causes and assisting in bringing those recommendations to fruition
  
  
Ensure procedures, work instructions, training, forms, intranet/share point documents are updated and relevant; create new documents as needed
  
  
Projects/Change Management
  
  
Participate in projects to optimize the P2F and reporting activities and the development of the GBS USSC. Collaborate with the GPO and local Finance and business staff to propose improvements. Be accountable for the implementation of continuous improvement of the end-to-end process and other services in the scope of responsibility and in close cooperation with the Global Process Owner (GPO), Regional CoE, and other stakeholders
  
  
Be a change leader in support of various initiatives. Proactively engage with the team, interfacing functions, global counterparts, and internal customers to endorse the need for change and address concerns
  
  
Prepare communications and training related to new/updated process and/or system functionality and deliver to stakeholders and customers
  
  
Test and validate system upgrades, reports, and data integrations
  
  
Specialized knowledge/capabilities
  
  
Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of concepts and practices not only within P2F but also in other functional and business areas which is used in the normal course of business to prepare forecasts and provide subject matter guidance
  
  
Stay current with the new developments in the marketplace, new technology capabilities (i.e. predictive forecasting, etc.), and personnel expense/benefit parameters in order to provide strategic direction to the P2F team and meaningful support to the region
  
  
Cross training and Development
  
  
Cross train in various areas to provide rotational, assigned, and/or backup support as needed
  
  
Responsibilities Continued
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Education Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's Degree Accounting, Finance, Business or other relevant area of study required
  
  
Experience Qualifications
  
  
4 or More Years Business analysis, financial planning, financial systems, or other related areas required
  
  
In-depth knowledge of SAP required
  
  
Proficiency in Excel, Word, Powerpoint required
  
  
In-depth knowledge of Master Data, and Planning tools/processes preferred
  
  
Proven track record of problem solving and issue resolution preferred
  
  
Exposure to pharmaceutical industry and PHARMA guidelines preferred

**About Children’s Specialized ABA**

Children’s Specialized ABA is part of the Children’s Specialized Hospital Autism Center of Excellence. We serve children with ASD by combining clinical innovation, whole-child care, and personalized therapy.? At Children’s Specialized ABA, we envision a future where every child diagnosed with autism has access to innovative and compassionate care, empowering them to thrive and reach their full potential. Our vision is built on four core values:

* **Inclusivity**: We celebrate the diversity within the Autism spectrum and are committed to creating an inclusive environment that respects and values each person’s individual strengths and differences.
* **Innovation**: We foster a culture of creativity and collaboration, exploring new ideas to develop personalized solutions that enhance quality of life for all children with Autism.
* **Connection**: We actively engage with the health systems and broader community to coordinate services and care for people with Autism.
* **Quality and Safety**: We invest in research and training to provide cutting-edge, effective, safe, and personalized services tailored to the unique needs of those we serve.

**Join Us as a Lead BCBA in our Social Connections Program!**

The Lead BCBA serves as the primary clinical leader for the after-school Social Connections Program while maintaining a center-based daytime caseload. This role combines clinical responsibilities with program oversight, staff development, quality assurance, and implementation support. The Lead BCBA supports participant placement, coaches staff, monitors treatment fidelity, and ensures individualized treatment goals are integrated into meaningful social learning opportunities. During program startup and growth, the Lead BCBA may also provide direct case oversight as additional BCBAs are hired and trained. This position collaborates with clinical, program development, and operational leadership to support program quality, growth, and long-term sustainability.

**About the Social Connections Program**

The Social Connections Program is a center-based, after-school ABA program for school-aged learners that combines individualized treatment with structured peer interactions. Through engaging social activities, learners build communication, social, emotional regulation, adaptive, and problem-solving skills in a supportive and collaborative environment. As a Lead BCBA, you will work a schedule of **10:45 a.m. to 7:15 p.m.**, providing clinical leadership and support during the program’s after-school service hours.

**Direct Clinical Responsibilities**

* Maintain direct BCBA service delivery and billable activity in alignment with organizational expectations
* Conduct comprehensive behavioral assessments and reassessments, including Functional Behavior Assessments (FBAs) and skills assessments, to identify target behaviors
* Train and supervise Behavior Technicians (BTs), Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs), and other team members on intervention strategies.
* Review and analyze clinical data regularly to guide treatment decisions and improve client outcomes
* Provide ongoing training and support to families, caregivers, and relevant stakeholders in behavioral strategies
* Provide treatment that is in accordance with BACB’s guidelines, policies, procedures, and ethical standards set forth by the Company

**Clinical Leadership**

* Serve as the primary clinical leader for the Social Connections Program ensuring fidelity of ABA programming across the center

* Provide program leadership through effective management of clinical operations, staffing, organizational priorities, and interdisciplinary collaboration
* Support participant placement and group composition to foster meaningful and mutually beneficial social skills groups
* Guide the development and implementation of clinical policies and procedures to ensure alignment between best clinical practices and operational decisions
* Serve as the clinical lead for escalated families, addressing compliance issues and complex clinical concerns
* Develop and deliver CEU training for BCBAs to maintain certification and build clinical skills

**Supervision and Staff Development**

* Provide leadership oversight, coaching, and performance feedback for assigned direct reports
* Conduct semiannual performance evaluations, identify individual development goals, and monitor quarterly and annual KPIs to ensure productivity and high performance of assigned direct reports
* Lead clinical meetings and promote a culture of collaboration, professional development, and clinical excellence
* Serve as the response supervisor for BCBAs, RBTs, and trainees pursuing certifications, providing clinical oversight through regular observation, feedback, coaching, and mentorship

**Program and Operational Oversight**

* Participate in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding of BCBAs, RBTs, and other program staff, partnering with HR and leadership on selection decisions

### **Description**

The Assistant Property/Operations Manager will be expected to take an active role in supporting the execution of a multitude of asset-level operational and development initiatives for one of New York City’s premier real estate investment firms under general direction from the firm’s Director of Operations. The Assistant Manager will have the rare opportunity to learn the real estate business through a multi-faceted lens and gain invaluable experience with a holistic view of the firm’s investment strategies. Additionally, the Analyst will benefit from regular engagement with Principals and senior management team members.

This dynamic role will initially be focused on daily operations of a commercial building in Astoria, Queens while lending field and office assistance for apartment turns, a light construction team, property management and project management across Stellar’s portfolio. Primary responsibilities will include managing and overseeing third party contractors, a light construction team, building staff, property operations, and ongoing development projects with the ultimate goal of achieving the financial and operational objectives of the portfolio.

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* Assist in managing and overseeing all building staff, property operations, and ongoing development projects to achieve the financial and operational objectives of the business plan
* Ability to assist in the management and deployment of a light construction crew and other field personnel including Superintendents.
* Collaborate with the Director of Business Operations and Asset Managers to understand property-specific goals and assist in implementing plans to achieve those objectives.
* Supervise and schedule apartment turnovers, coordinating with cleaning, painting, and maintenance teams to ensure standards and deadlines are met.
* Execute on Key Performance Indicators as defined in the business plan
* Assist with the hiring, training/onboarding, scheduling, and management of on-site building staff
* Work with management to prepare and maintain operating and capital budgets and support the implementation and execution of construction projects on site
* Assist procuring and monitoring third-party vendors and the reporting on status of ongoing projects
* Compile and ensure completion of construction punch lists including project close-out documentation
* Process and track vendor invoicing via AIA documents, lien waivers, & contractor affidavits
* Assist in reviewing contracts, vendors, staffing, and maintenance practices to identify expense reductions
* Oversee the lease renewal process and help negotiate renewal terms to retain occupancy for three rental buildings in the portfolio
* Coordinate curing of DOB, DOH, HPD, DEC, DEP, & LPC violations
* Oversee resident services and communications to achieve high customer satisfaction and retention
* Work with the maintenance team to ensure that apartments, common areas and grounds are maintained
* Assist with the leasing process when necessary, including pricing, marketing, showings, and issuing new leases
* Oversee turnover process of recently vacated apartments to ensure quality results and timely completion
* Attend to emergencies on-site outside of normal business hours if/when needed
* Additional operational tasks include: monitoring and handling resident payments and collections with the accounting department, preparing accident and insurance claims, and scheduling tenant move-ins / outs.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent preferred
* 1-3 years of relevant of experience in property management
* Bilingual (Spanish) a plus
* 5 days on-site required (corporate and field)
* **Ability to travel to, and around, the Bronx and Yonkers locations**
* Ability to safely navigate a construction site
* Must be able to sit and stand for extended periods of time.
* Must be able to communicate both on the phone and in person with our clients to resolve issues and manage the business.
* A commitment to performing high-quality work in a collaborative environment on a growing team.
* Ability to prioritize, identify and implement operational initiatives.
* Ability to demonstrate self-motivation and an intellectual curiosity with a dedication to continually find ways to positively impact operational processes and key personnel to improve property-level performance.
* Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to effectively communicate with individuals across all levels of the firm including building staff, leasing teams, and senior management.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and manage a team
* Strong organization skills with a penchant for paying attention to detail.
* Strong customer service and verbal/written communication skills
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word. Experience with Yardi software and CMS helpful, but not required.
* Knowledge of building systems and building maintenance preferred.
* Familiarity with local real estate laws and regulations helpful, but not required.

Founded in 1985, Stellar Management is a New York City based real estate investment and management firm. With a mix of residential, office, and retail space under the firm’s corporate umbrella, Stellar is an active market participant focused exclusively on New York City. Since its inception, Stellar has built its superior track record on owning and managing properties for a diverse array of residential, retail and office users. jobs.description:
**The Company**

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

**Job Summary:**

PayPal's Corporate Development team is looking for a Senior Analyst to help identify, evaluate, and execute acquisitions that advance the strategic and financial objectives of the company and its business divisions. This role is for someone who has built a strong foundation in investment banking and wants to move from advising on transactions to owning them, seeing a deal through from first idea to signed agreement to integration.
  
  
You will work directly with senior leaders across PayPal's businesses and support functions to understand each division's strategic priorities and identify where M&A can accelerate growth or strengthen the business. You'll evaluate potential targets, lead diligence, build deal models, and run valuation analyses, then distill your findings into clear recommendations that inform decisions at the executive and board level.

**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Assist in the coordination and execution of deal activities, including due diligence and post-deal integration
* Prepare investment memos and support in financial model analysis
* Monitor portfolio companies and track key performance indicators
* Assist in the preparation of presentations, meetings, and communication materials
* Collaborate with the investment team on various projects and initiatives
* Provide insights based on market and financial analysis
* Work effectively within teams and foster cross-functional collaboration
* Multitask and prioritize assignments to meet deadlines
* Support the development of business cases and evaluate investment opportunities

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications****:**

* 2-4 years of experience in investment banking, corporate development, private equity, or a similar transaction-focused role
* Background in fintech, consumer technology, or consumer financial services, whether through banking coverage, investing, corporate strategy, or an operating role
* Strong financial modeling and valuation skills, including DCF, trading comparables, precedent transactions, and accretion/dilution analysis
* Experience supporting transactions through multiple phases, including target screening, due diligence, negotiation, signing, close, and post-close integration
* Sound judgment and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams under tight deal timelines
* A strategic owner's mindset: curious about how our businesses operate and why a deal makes sense, not only financially but operationally and strategically

**Job Description**
-------------------

New York City Emergency Management (NYCEM) helps New Yorkers before, during, and after emergencies through preparedness, education, and response. NYCEM is responsible for coordinating citywide emergency planning and response for all types and scales of emergencies. We are staffed by more than 200 dedicated professionals with diverse backgrounds and areas of expertise, including individuals assigned from other City agencies.
  
  
The Office of the Chief Operating Officer (COO) is comprised of Human Capital Management (HCM), Information Technology (IT), Support Services, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS). The Office of the COO is focused on implementing agency initiatives and strategies and incorporating them into daily operations to meet agency objectives and goals.
  
  
The NYCEM Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Unit produces reliable location-based information through the integration, analysis, and visualization of essential data distributed in the form of maps, datasets, summary metrics, and associated applications.
  
NYCEM has an exciting opportunity for a motivated GIS Specialist to join the Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Division at New York City Emergency Management (NYCEM).
  
  
Under the supervision of the Deputy Director, Public Safety GIS Data Development Center, the selected applicant will work as a GIS Specialist to analyze, visualize and report on geospatial information to support the agency’s executive, planning, and operations staff. The GIS Specialist will work as part of the Division’s Public Safety GIS Data Development Center to perform data acquisition, QA/QC, data maintenance, and data management tasks. In addition, the applicant will create map templates, paper maps, and web applications in support of preparedness and response operations. The selected applicant will also work on python-based GIS tools, to support geospatial data science and administrative workflows. The selected applicant will serve as an early-career GIS specialist within a team of GIS professionals.
  
  
In addition, the selected applicant will:
  
Identify and acquire citywide data resources from NYC OpenData, geospatial data services, and partner agencies.
  

* Support GIS staff and agency users with the development and deployment of geospatial data and related tools.
* Perform detailed QA/QC on key datasets and maintain data consistency between NYCEM's on-premises and cloud-based environments.
* Accept ad hoc rapid data acquisition, mapping, geospatial analysis, and reporting requests.
* Contribute to the production of scripts, models, and tools in a desktop GIS environment.
* Create applications, dashboards, and experiences in Esri Enterprise and ArcGIS Online.
* Collect, analyze and display GIS data using applications including but not limited to: ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, Fulcrum, Tableau, Microsoft and Adobe products.
* Support GIS staff and agency users with development and deployment of GIS applications and data collection tools.
* Assist in the management of the GIS knowledge base, including but not limited to overseeing related documents, templates, and workflows.
* Assist in the development of training and exercise programs for GIS and non-GIS staff.

jobs.description:
Talcott Financial Group\* is an international life insurance company committed to providing comprehensive risk solutions to its customers. Whether it’s providing peace of mind for policyholders approaching retirement, or helping insurers solve complex risk and capital challenges, Talcott delivers practical solutions that support long-term stability for policyholders and clients.
  
  
Talcott offers the strength of an established organization with the mindset and approach of a modern platform. The enterprise is supported by a proven track record of well-executed transactions, investment-grade financial strength ratings, and strong financial position, with over $136 billion in assets under management. Talcott also benefits from a strategic partnership with Sixth Street, a leading global investment firm managing over $135 billion in assets.
  
  
Talcott’s approach to business is disciplined, transparent, and multi-channel, spanning retail annuities, block and flow reinsurance, and legal entity acquisitions. We have offices in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, Connecticut, New York, and North Carolina.
  
  
Position Overview
  
We are seeking an Investment Analyst to join our Strategic Asset Allocation (SAA) Design team in a new role. The successful candidate will design and build the analytical tools that power our SAA process in developing asset allocation strategies and supporting the asset deployment planning. We are looking for a candidate who can use AI-assisted tools to deliver well-validated working models that can be put into production to support dynamic business needs. The role will reside within the Market Risk Capital team, which is responsible for producing Market Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA) and capital results for the Firm Risk Management Department (FRM). These results are key inputs into regulatory reporting, capital management, and internal business decision-making.

  

We are seeking a highly motivated Analyst with 1-3 years of experience to report directly to the Global Head of Market Risk Capital. The successful candidate will support US Market Risk Capital production and related controls, while also contributing to the governance framework and strategic priorities of the global Market Risk Capital organization.

This highly visible role offers broad exposure to stakeholders across Risk, Finance, Capital, Technology, and business units. It is well suited for an early-career candidate who combines strong analytical, organizational, communication, and project coordination skills with an interest in market risk, regulatory capital, and capital production processes.

Primary Responsibilities
  
> Support the Global Head of Market Risk Capital and work closely with US and regional Market Risk Capital teams to execute production, governance, regulatory, and organizational priorities.
  
> Support project management for priority initiatives across the global Market Risk Capital organization, including regulatory change programs, operating model enhancements, process transformation efforts, and other strategic projects.
  
> Help maintain and enhance the Market Risk Capital governance framework, including governance standards, policies and procedures, review and challenge processes, attestations, committee governance, management reporting, and escalation protocols.
  
> Work with Market Risk teams in the US and EMEA, and support coordination across Risk Analytics, Model Risk Management, Firm Capital, Finance, Technology, and business units to manage production dependencies and deliver against agreed objectives.

> Perform analytical reviews of US Market Risk Capital results and support efforts to strengthen controls, data quality, transparency, reporting, automation, and operational efficiency across capital production processes.
  
> Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, process validation reviews, and other production- and governance-related activities.
  
> Perform ad hoc capital analyses and contribute to special projects in support of management decision-making and the broader objectives of the Market Risk Capital organization.

  

You Have:

> Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.

> Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear and concise materials for senior management audiences.
  
> Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with close attention to detail.
  
> Ability to build effective working relationships and engage stakeholders across functions and levels of seniority, with appropriate guidance.
  
> Exposure to capital production, regulatory reporting, governance frameworks, regulatory initiatives, operating model development, or process improvement is preferred.
  
> Experience or coursework in market risk, regulatory capital, financial products, or broader risk management concepts is preferred. Familiarity with Basel capital frameworks and Market Risk RWA is a plus.
  
> Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Experience working with large datasets or reporting and visualization tools is a plus.

jobs.title: Trade CRM Specialist
jobs.description:
### **Position**

**Are you ready for a world of possibilities?**

You embark on a career journey with the leaders of luxury wines, champagnes, and spirits, within the prestigious LVMH Group. From nature to communities, you’ll craft unforgettable experiences that drive the collective success of our 26 Maisons – each one with a unique heritage and set within the most remarkable terroirs the world has to offer. **You enter a world of possibility** where career development opportunities across our Maisons, our 5 global regions, and the entire LVMH Group, are unmatched. You **join a passionate community of talents** that spans four generations and combines a wealth of roles and skillsets from the roots of the vine to the glass and everything in between **. You discover our essential** **relationship** with our terroirs, and how we nurture and preserve the soils which are the source of our singular products. Our global Living Soils Living Together program has four key commitments for 2030: regenerating soils, mitigating our climate impact, engaging society, and empowering our people **. You will share in our passion** for hosting, for art-de-vivre as well as our pride in creating products that celebrate life’s most memorable milestones, while always experienced through measured, responsible tasting.

**Moët Hennessy** is proud to promote a diverse, equitable and inclusive working environment for all. As an employer, Moët Hennessy offers unique journeys throughout its global ecosystem, opportunities to develop new skills and grow professionally. If you want to inspire and be inspired, to craft experiences and experience the best in craftsmanship, this is where you’ll flourish.

The Trade CRM Specialist is a change enablement role that combines strategic, analytical, and operational responsibilities, with a strong focus on user support, training, and adoption of MHUSA’s Trade CRM ecosystem, known internally as ASPIRE, which combines Salesforce for customer relationship management and sales execution with Power BI for reporting, analytics, and data visualization. The role helps Commercial teams effectively leverage these platforms to streamline day-to-day activities, improve customer engagement, and drive more informed, data-driven decision-making.

Working cross-functionally with internal stakeholders, the Trade CRM Specialist serves as a key resource for end users, providing ongoing training, troubleshooting, and guidance to maximize platform adoption and business value. The role also supports the development of actionable dashboards, reporting capabilities, and analytics aligned with MHUSA’s commercial priorities, while promoting best practices and continuous improvement across the organization.

***Office/Location: Hybrid 3x a week based out of*** ***NYC Office***

Compensation: $67,000-$80,000/ Annually + Bonus

### **Job responsibilities**

**Role and Responsibilities**

**1.** **User Training, Support & Adoption**

Serve as a primary resource for day-to-day user support across ASPIRE, Power BI, and related reporting tools. Lead new-user onboarding, deliver ongoing training, troubleshoot functional issues, and develop practical learning materials, including presentations, videos, and quick-reference guides. Support platform rollouts and adoption initiatives, helping users confidently navigate systems, access reports, and incorporate these tools into their daily workflows.

**2.** **Platform Optimization & Continuous Improvement**

Gather and document business requirements and relevant information to effectively triage, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues in collaboration with technical teams. Coordinate testing, validation, and implementation of bug fixes and enhancements, while maintaining clear and timely communication with impacted users and departments throughout the resolution process. Ensure issues are tracked through completion. Identify opportunities to improve platform functionality, streamline workflows, and enhance the user experience.

  

**3.** **Performance Analytics & Reporting**

Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, Salesforce reports, and analytical tools that provide actionable insights into Commercial performance. Monitor key performance indicators, evaluate sales execution and activation effectiveness, and conduct trend and root cause analyses to identify performance gaps and opportunities for improvement. Ensure reporting aligns with business priorities and supports informed decision-making across the organization.

**4.** **Data Stewardship & Quality Assurance**

Support data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across Salesforce and Power BI. Investigate data discrepancies, identify underlying issues, and coordinate with Data and IT teams on resolution. Promote data quality standards and best practices to ensure reliable reporting and maintain confidence in the underlying information.

**5.** **Data Analytics Best Practices**

Promote a data-driven culture by sharing analytical best practices, collaborating with other analysts/specialists, and helping stakeholders build their understanding of available tools and insights. Contribute to MHUSA's broader analytics community and support the adoption of consistent reporting methodologies and performance measurement standards across teams.

### **Profile**

**Education:**

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

Additional certifications or training in Salesforce, Microsoft Power BI, or data analytics are a plus.

**Professional Experience:**

2+ years of professional experience in sales, marketing, business analytics, or a related field. Experience in the wine and spirits industry is a plus.

**Practical/Technical Knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience working with Salesforce CRM, including user support, reporting, and platform functionality.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft

jobs.title: Manager, Global Consumer Insights & Research
jobs.description:
The NFL's Marketing Strategy, Planning & Insights team serves as a center of excellence for the League, shaping how the NFL grows fans, strengthens the brand, and drives engagement across the U.S. and international markets. The team brings together consumer insights, audience strategy, business planning, initiative-level strategy, and performance measurement to ground decisions in fan understanding, market dynamics, and business priorities. Partnering across business functions and key stakeholders (e.g., the 32 NFL Clubs, partners), the team delivers actionable insights, strategic guidance, and planning frameworks that inform both long-term strategy and day-to-day decisions.

Within this team, Consumer Insights designs and conducts primary research, integrates syndicated and first-party data, and delivers actionable insights across global fan development, brand health, media, live events, marketing effectiveness, partnerships, social responsibility, and player-related priorities.

The Manager, Global Strategic Insights supports research development, analysis, and insights generation to inform global fan development and business growth. The role conducts and synthesizes primary research, syndicated sources, first-party data, and market intelligence to ensure Leaguewide decision-making is grounded in a fan-first perspective.

**Responsibilities**

**Global Fandom Intelligence**

* Monitor fandom, avidity, engagement, and brand health, as well as the drivers of and barriers to each.
* Analyze cultural, behavioral, and regional differences to identify opportunities to acquire, develop, engage, and monetize fans.
* Leverage NFL-specific and macro landscape insights to support the development of audience-level strategies by demographic, market, and other relevant segmentation lenses, such as engagement level and football knowledge.

**Strategic Insights & Business Planning**

* Support strategic analyses, forecasts, scenario planning, and performance measurement tied to near- and long-range priorities.
* Connect fan behavior, research findings, and marketplace trends to business opportunities and actionable recommendations.
* Develop executive-ready presentations, memos, and key planning documents.

**Consumer Insights & Research Execution**

* Support qualitative and quantitative research from objective setting and methodology selection through questionnaire or discussion guide development, analysis, and reporting.
* Manage day-to-day stakeholder and vendor coordination, timelines, and deliverables across multiple projects.
* Synthesize primary research, syndicated data, first-party information, and secondary sources into concise, story-driven visuals and recommendations using best-in-class practices.

**Brand, Media & Marketing Effectiveness**

* Measure brand campaigns, creative effectiveness, audience sentiment, cultural relevance, and other equity measures across markets and fan segments.
* Analyze broadcast, streaming, direct-to-consumer, content, and emerging viewing experiences to inform audience growth, media, product, and marketing strategies.
* Evaluate new products, events, experiences, and fan engagement initiatives across the NFL ecosystem.

**Stakeholder Partnership & Team Contribution**

* Build collaborative relationships across the League, Clubs, markets, and external research partners, advocating for fan-centric, insight-driven decisions.
* Communicate complex research through clear, concise storytelling tailored to varied audiences.
* Coordinate multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, timing, and business relevance.
* Support junior team members through coaching and project guidance, and improve research processes, reporting standards, and insight socialization.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of relevant experience in consumer insights, market research, strategy, analytics, or a related field.
* Ability to translate business questions into research objectives and quantitative or qualitative research plans.
* Demonstrated ability to synthesize complex findings and communicate concise, actionable insights to varied stakeholders.
* Strong data visualization and storytelling skills, with experience creating executive-ready presentations and insight-driven reports.
* Strong project management, cross-functional collaboration, and relationship-building skills in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with research methods such as segmentation, surveys, ethnography, interviews, and focus groups, plus familiarity with syndicated media measurement and applied analytics.
* Proficiency with analytical tools such as Microsoft Excel, SPSS, or Q.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent professional experience.

**Other Key Attributes / Characteristics**

* Experience managing vendors and/or analysts; strong people management capabilities preferred.
* Familiarity with sports and entertainment; knowledge of media and live events is a plus.
* Experience working with global or multinational businesses and measurement frameworks strongly preferred.
* Spanish, Portuguese, French, and/or German language proficiency is a plus.
* Master’s degree in Market Research preferred.

* Some travel required

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Senior Analyst, Business DevelopmentOverview  
The Global Partnerships team is responsible for cultivating and managing Mastercard’s most strategic relationships with key players across the payments ecosystem. The team works with global leaders in technology, e-commerce and financial services to build and scale solutions across acceptance, issuing and co-brand partnerships, payments services and emerging commerce capabilities.

Job Description

**The Role**

As a Cyber Incident Response Analyst, you will be part of the Cyber Defence team that develops and oversees the company's security program, ensuring S&P Global is protected from existing and emerging threats. In close partnership with Security Operations and Threat Intelligence, you will detect, analyze, and decisively respond to security incidents, enrich investigations with timely intelligence, and help drive proactive defences. While based in the UK, you will support response and intelligence needs globally.

Candidates should have a genuine interest in cyber security and a strong grasp of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs). This role requires a detail-oriented, critical thinker who understands how adversaries exploit systems, networks, and people—and how to respond. Experience applying threat intelligence to investigations and to improve detections is highly desirable.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and triage response to cybersecurity events and conduct forensic analysis across endpoints, networks, cloud, and SaaS.
* Integrate threat intelligence into investigations (e.g., enrich IOCs, map activity to MITRE ATT&CK, identify likely threat actors/TTPs, and assess potential impact).
* Understand the threat landscape through collaboration with industry peers, FS-ISAC, trust groups, and commercial/open-source intelligence, translating insights into actionable recommendations.
* Develop, maintain, and operationalize Incident Response playbooks and SOPs; include PIRs (Priority Intelligence Requirements), collection plans, and feedback loops to refine detections.
* Work closely with the SOC to investigate incidents and deliver containment, remediation, and root cause analysis; produce high-quality intel-informed incident reports.
* Create and tune detections (e.g., SIEM/SOAR, EDR) using intelligence signals (TTPs, behaviors, YARA/Sigma where applicable).
* Produce and present consumable intelligence outputs (e.g., flash alerts, threat overviews, executive briefs) tailored to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to vulnerability/threat surfacing (e.g., emerging CVEs, exploit trends) and advise on risk-based prioritization.
* Deliver actionable incident and hunting metrics to management; assess detection coverage and recommend improvements.
* Follow the end-to-end incident response lifecycle and support post-incident lessons learned with intelligence-driven enhancements.
* Build an understanding of key S&P technology, systems, and business practices to contextualize threats and drive pragmatic defenses.
* Participate in information-sharing activities (e.g., FS-ISAC submissions) in line with TLP and legal/compliance requirements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of common cyber attacks, tools, and attacker tradecraft; ability to map activity to MITRE ATT&CK and articulate likely TTPs.
* Demonstrated experience handling security events in critical environments and applying intelligence to accelerate triage and response.
* Experience analyzing system, application, and cloud/SaaS logs to investigate security and operational issues; comfort enriching with IOCs and behaviours.
* Hands-on experience with a SIEM (Splunk preferred) for investigations, alert creation, reporting, and threat hunting.
* Ability to produce clear, actionable intel and incident reports, including executive-ready summaries and visuals.
* Familiarity with threat intel workflows: collection planning, source evaluation, indicator lifecycle, PIRs, TLP, and feedback loops to detections.
* Experience with one or more TIPs or intel data sources (e.g., MISP, OpenCTI, Recorded Future) and STIX/TAXII concepts.
* 3+ years of information security experience with a focus on incident response, threat hunting, or threat intelligence.
* Excellent communication skills for varied business and technical audiences; strong presentation skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment; passion for cyber security.
* Advanced knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and operating systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the financial services industry.
* Familiarity with threat hunting techniques (hypothesis-driven, ATT&CK-aligned, behavior-based).
* Windows and Linux administration tools and concepts.
* Understanding of threat actors and the cybercrime ecosystem, including initial access vectors, monetization paths, and supply-chain/SaaS attack patterns.
* Exposure to malware/TTP analysis at a functional level (family identification, persistence/discovery behaviors) and creation of detections (e.g., Sigma/YARA) is a plus.
* Experience producing finished intelligence products (tactical through executive) and briefing senior stakeholders.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., GCTI, GCFA/GCFR, GCIH, FOR578) or equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with information-sharing standards and practices (FS-ISAC, TLP) and legal/compliance considerations.
* Knowledge of cloud provider threat models and telemetry (AWS, Azure, GCP, M365/SaaS).
* Second language and/or geopolitical awareness for actor context is a plus.

**Glencore**, headquartered in Baar, Switzerland is one of the world's leading integrated producers and marketers of commodities that industries around the world need. Glencore has worldwide activities in the production, sourcing, processing, refining, transporting, storage, financing and supply of metals and minerals, energy products, and agricultural products. We strive to be a reliable and competitive partner in the markets in which we serve and to support our customers and suppliers at each stage of their expansion and development.

**Glencore Ltd**, a US-based branch of Glencore AG, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Glencore International AG, where it employees approximately 300 people.

  

**Structured Finance Analyst (New York, NY)**

  

**Department:** Oil Project and Structured Finance (OPSF)

  

**Overview:**

  

The Structured Finance Analyst will support Glencore's global oil trading activities by assisting the Oil & Gas Project and Structured Finance Department in executing complex transactions related to M&A and debt financing. This role will focus on opportunities in both North and South America and will involve collaboration with trading desks to identify and structure bankable transactions.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Market Analysis:**

* Track market trends, pricing dynamics and regulatory developments for financing structures in the upstream, midstream, and downstream space.
* Conduct market monitoring and networking with corporates, investors, and advisors (including legal counsel).

**Transaction Evaluation:**

* Evaluate investment opportunities across the oil & gas value chain, with responsibility for cash flow modelling, scenario analysis, risk/return assessments, and due diligence support.
* Develop and maintain financial models for structured transactions, including acquisitions, commodity-linked financings, asset-backed securitizations, and project finance structures.

**Transaction Structuring and Execution:**

* Support deal structuring and execution by preparing internal investment memos, presentations, and term sheets.
* Coordinate internal and external stakeholders, manage deal documentation, and facilitate negotiations.
* Collaborate with external legal advisers to assess risk profiles, legal structures, and enforcement mechanisms involved in transactions.
* Work alongside other team members to structure and syndicate transactions, ensuring they align with Glencore's marketing division strategy.

**Transaction Monitoring:**

* Collaborate with legal, operations, and risk teams to support ongoing monitoring of structured deals.
* Manage and update models, providing ongoing performance analysis.

**Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Maintain and expand relationships with banks, investors, and other key stakeholders to widen the pool of participants in financing transactions.
  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in investment banking, structured finance, M&A, or asset management, with experience in energy and/or infrastructure a plus.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a keen understanding of financial modeling and transaction structuring and a proven track record in building complex financial models.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively liaise with various stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
* Proficient in Excel, Powerpoint, and financial databases; VBA, Python or SQL is a plus.
  

**Compensation:**

  

* The expected base salary ranges from $120,000 -$140,000. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, certifications and licenses obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered. In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus.
