11

**The Team**

Credit Ratings is an integral part of S&P Global's Global Ratings Services, bringing together a diverse group of more than 1,400 analysts across key financial centers worldwide. The Corporates Ratings practice delivers forward-looking credit insights on a wide range of corporate entities, producing independent rating opinions that markets and investors rely on to understand how evolving risks affect financial stability and credit performance. The team provides analytical coverage of corporate issuers across the Transportation, Automotive, Aerospace & Defense, and Engineering & Construction sectors, monitoring industry trends, evaluating company performance and credit risk, and contributing to the ongoing assessment and maintenance of credit ratings.

  
  

**Responsibilities and Impact**

Impact

This role plays a key part in delivering the independent, rigorous credit analysis that underpins S&P Global Ratings' trusted, decision-ready intelligence. The Senior Analyst leads analysis for an assigned corporate portfolio, synthesizing complex financial and market data into clear, committee-ready rating opinions. By integrating AI-enabled tools with deep analytical expertise, the role drives productivity, quality, and consistency across the credit process — contributing to analysis that informs investors, issuers, and market participants globally.

  
  

Responsibilities

Team Contribution & Capability Building

* Provide day-to-day coaching and guidance to Research Assistants and Rating Analysts, building capability in credit analysis, data discipline, and analytical tooling while reinforcing values-driven behaviors.
* Drive consistency and scalability by codifying standard work and promoting the disciplined adoption of shared analytical practices across the team.
* Strengthen AI-enabled productivity by developing reusable assets and proposing lightweight automations that free capacity for higher-value human analysis and relationship work.
* Partner with senior team members and Data and Engineering colleagues to identify, design, and scale AI and automation use cases with governance built in from the outset.
  

  

Core Analytical & Delivery

* Lead end-to-end execution for assigned credits, ensuring high-quality analysis and timely delivery with clear accountability across priorities.
* Own ongoing surveillance for an assigned portfolio, synthesizing performance data, market signals, and peer context into decision-useful insights with clear risk implications.
* Support the embedding of AI and automation tools into analytical workflows, applying structured validation and analytical judgment to maintain the integrity and reliability of conclusions.
* Prepare and review key analytical outputs — including model inputs, metrics, assumptions, and published reports — ensuring alignment with methodology, sector frameworks, and evidentiary standards.
  

  

Stakeholder & Market Engagement

* Engage with external parties alongside senior team members, communicating complex analysis clearly and with credibility.
* Craft client- and executive-ready narratives that translate data, research, and analysis into clear, actionable stories.
* Build trusted stakeholder relationships through collaborative, adaptable, and analytically confident delivery.
  

  

Risk Management and Operating

* Ensure adherence to methodology, confidentiality requirements, and data governance standards; escalate issues early with clear options and recommendations to protect analytical integrity.
* Embed responsible, governed AI use into day-to-day workflows, using only approved tools and data while protecting confidential information at all times.
* Support the design, testing, and rollout of controlled automation and AI-assisted workflows, contributing to guardrail definitions that distinguish what can be automated from what must remain human-led.
  

  

**Compensation/Benefits Information (US Candidates)**

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $100,000 to $154,000 USD. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual's geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here .

  
  

**What We're Looking For**

Required Skills and Experience:

* An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in corporate credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related field.
* Demonstrated credit, financial, and risk analysis skills, with the ability to connect key drivers to forward-looking risk views and actionable credit opinions.
* Practical experience embedding AI tools, large language models (LLMs), or automation into analytical workflows to improve productivity and analytical insight.
* Proficiency in analytical tools, with a willingness to learn data and automation platforms that support AI-enabled workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex analysis into concise, evidence-based narratives for senior stakeholders and rating committees.
* High standards for quality, traceability, and governance, with sound judgment on the responsible use of AI in a controlled analytical environment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple credits and competing priorities, delivering high-quality work with limited oversight.
  

  

Preferred or Helpful Experience:

* Coaching or mentoring experience that has contributed to improved team capability, consistency, or the adoption of shared analytical standards.
* Experience contributing to process improvement, automation design, or the rollout of AI-assisted workflows.

jobs.title: Financial Analyst, Inventory Quality Finance, Defect Cost Controllership (DCC)
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Every defect whether damaged, defective, missorted package or item has a cost story behind it, and you'll be the one uncovering it and quantifying it so you can drive the fix. Amazon's Central Operations Finance team is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to serve as a trusted finance partner for Defect Cost Controllership (DCC), supporting operational and functional leaders across the network.  
  
The NACF DCC finance team provides cost controllership and project return on investment alongside financial insights for end-to-end defect reduction processes and initiatives across the supply chain. This role will directly influence controllership over defect costs spanning damages, concessions, and missorts, driving measurable cost reduction across fulfillment centers. Our team translates operational KPIs into financial impact so stakeholders have the most current and reliable information to make the best possible decisions for Amazon.  
  
As DCC expands its scope and takes on end-to-end defect reduction workstreams, we need a Senior Financial Analyst to help scale our controllership and cost insights capabilities. The team is investing in automated defect cost attribution and expanded reporting coverage while building new financial models to support warehouse damages initiatives.  
  
You'll work with SQL, Excel, and financial systems like SAP to build models and mine large-scale data while automating reporting. This role sits within the NACF Finance organization and partners closely with operations, Retail & FBA business partners, and customer service finance teams. Your time will be split between deep analytical work, building forecasts, cost bridges, and ROI models, and collaborative sessions with cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategy and present findings to senior leadership.  
  
There is significant room to grow in this role. You'll gain exposure to senior leaders and deep expertise across multiple cost domains, plus the opportunity to shape how DCC approaches financial controllership as the team scales.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own end-to-end financial planning cycles including forecast modeling, variance bridging, network partnership, and presentations to senior leadership.
* Analyze large-scale quantitative data to build meaningful reports that drive defect cost reduction strategy and business improvement.
* Validate project financials to ensure accurate return-on-investment insights and track financial impact against budget baselines.
* Partner with senior stakeholders to align on cost strategy, challenge assumptions with data, and communicate financial insights clearly across audiences.
* Build and automate scalable processes that improve efficiency across finance workflows related to defect costs.

  
A day in the life  
The DCC team focuses on finance controllership, cost savings, and end-to-end defect cost reduction across North America Customer Fulfillment. Your primary focus will be on workstreams that identify opportunities leading to cost reduction and process improvement that strengthen financial controllership. You'll also own project financial validations and return-on-investment analyses while tracking financial impact on budget baselines. The team plays a key role in decision making and developing financial insights as part of monthly and quarterly business reviews, leading cost business reviews, and providing ad-hoc analysis on large or ambiguous deliverables. Recent projects have ranged from building automated cost bridges for monthly business reviews to quantifying the financial impact of new defect reduction pilots across the network.  
  
About the team  
The DCC team supports multiple teams across North America Customer Fulfillment and collaborates with NA Quality, Customer Service, and end-to-end financial controllership. In cases of worldwide workstreams, the team collaborates with business partners across the globe. What sets this team apart is the breadth of exposure. You'll work across every major defect category in the fulfillment network, partnering with operators and finance leaders alike to turn cost data into action.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
* Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
* MBA, or CPA
* Experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
* 3+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis

Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. Positioned as a technical lead working alongside payroll associates and reporting into HR and Finance leadership, this senior role serves as the primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) for both ADP Workforce Now and Workday Payroll platforms. jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Business Development
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Senior Analyst, Business DevelopmentOverview  
The Global Partnerships team is responsible for cultivating and managing Mastercard’s most strategic relationships with key players across the payments ecosystem. The team works with global leaders in technology, e-commerce and financial services to build and scale solutions across acceptance, issuing and co-brand partnerships, payments services and emerging commerce capabilities.  
  
Join an agile, high-performing team within Mastercard’s Global Acceptance vertical, focused on growing the Global Acquiring business with leading centralized global acquirers and commerce enablers.  
  
These customers are central to Mastercard’s acceptance strategy and operate across multiple markets, channels and business models. The team works closely with regional stakeholders, product teams and customer partners to defend and grow revenue, deepen relationships and execute priority strategic initiatives.  
  
Reporting to the Vice President, Business Development, this Sr. Analyst role will provide hands-on support across a portfolio of key strategic accounts. The role will work closely with senior account leads to help manage day-to-day customer engagement, coordinate internal stakeholders, progress commercial opportunities and ensure strong execution of strategic account priorities.  
  
The role offers the opportunity to build deep expertise in global account management, business development, acquiring, commerce platforms and emerging payments, while gaining exposure to complex global customers and cross-functional initiatives across Mastercard.  
  
Role  
Strategic Account Support  

* Support Global enablers lead in the day-to-day management of selected key global strategic accounts.
* Develop a strong understanding of each customer’s business, priorities, operating model and strategic agenda to help identify where Mastercard can add value.
* Help prepare for customer meetings, executive engagements, business reviews and strategic workshops, including agendas, briefing materials, presentations and follow-up actions.
* Maintain clear account plans, priorities, actions and deliverables to ensure commitments are progressed and key initiatives remain on track.

  
Client Engagement & Relationship Management  

* Support regular engagement with customers across business, product and commercial topics.
* Coordinate customer requests and ensure the right Mastercard teams are engaged to provide timely and high-quality responses.
* Support the preparation and delivery of QBRs, strategic reviews and other key customer touchpoints.

  
Commercial & Business Development Support  

* Assist with customer proposals, RFP responses, commercial discussions, business cases and internal approval processes.
* Coordinate inputs from product, services, legal, finance, regional and other cross-functional teams to support deal development and execution.
* Support senior team members on strategic deals, negotiations and new partnership initiatives.

  
Cross-Functional Execution  

* Act as a connector across Mastercard teams and markets to support the execution of global account priorities..
* Follow up on actions and dependencies arising from customer and internal meetings and help drive them through to completion.
* Help ensure relevant internal stakeholders remain aligned on account priorities, customer commitments and upcoming milestones.

  
All About You  

* You are proactive, organised and commercially minded, with a strong interest in customers and relationship management.
* You have experience or exposure to account management, business development, partnerships, sales, or another client-facing commercial role.
* You are comfortable supporting complex strategic customers and managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and workstreams at the same time.
* You communicate clearly and confidently and can prepare high-quality customer and executive-level materials.
* You have strong relationship-building skills and enjoy working collaboratively across functions, markets and seniority levels.
* You demonstrate ownership, attention to detail and a strong bias toward execution and follow-through.
* Familiarity with the payments ecosystem, digital commerce, acquiring, commerce platforms or emerging payments trends is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree required.

  
What Success Looks Like  
Success in this role means becoming a trusted and highly effective partner to the global enablers team and the customers they manage, helping the team deliver a consistently strong customer experience and execute strategic priorities with pace and discipline.  
You will help the team:  

* Deepen relationships with key strategic customers.
* Improve the quality and consistency of customer engagement and account management.
* Progress commercial opportunities and strategic initiatives from discussion through execution.
* Ensure customer commitments, actions and cross-functional workstreams are well coordinated and delivered.
* Strengthen internal alignment around account priorities and upcoming milestones.
* Enable senior account leads to spend more time on strategic relationship development and commercial growth.

new_jobs.title: HR Compliance Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

The HR Compliance Analyst supports Related’s HR Compliance function across a multi-state workforce, helping ensure our policies, practices, and processes adhere to applicable laws, regulations, and internal standards and proactively identify and mitigate compliance risks. The role sits at the intersection of HR and Legal, with hands-on exposure to employment law, litigation support, background screening, and immigration compliance. This position is full-time, reports to the HR Compliance Manager, and will be based in our New York office three days a week. Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Regulatory & Policy Compliance

* Monitor new and existing federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations, and summarize key changes and their impact for the team.
* Maintain compliance calendar and tracker (e.g., statutory deadlines and effective dates).
* Gather data and ensure accuracy for regulatory reports.
* Oversee labor law poster process (e.g., ordering posters, coordinating with business stakeholders, and processing invoices).
* Coordinate OSHA and workers’ compensation poster process with internal stakeholders.
* Support policy and handbook review, updates, and rollout, including state-specific supplements and translations.
* Draft guidance memos for internal stakeholders on new and changing state and local requirements
* Assist with vetting and onboarding third party vendors.
* Monitor and track third party vendor and outside counsel invoices against budgets.
* Support background check compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including preparing fair chance notices within required timelines.
* Assist with the development of clear and engaging training content on evolving regulations and policy refreshers for internal stakeholders.
* Provide general support for compliance-specific projects (e.g., self-audits, tracking deadlines and responses, organizing meetings, and initiating follow up).

Employee Agreements & Employment Litigation

* Prepare, distribute, and track litigation hold notices, acknowledgments, and releases.
* Draft severance agreements and separation letters using approved templates.
* Track severance and settlement payment deadlines, including signatures and revocation periods, and coordinate with Payroll.
* Pull and prepare employee files in response to subpoenas, agency requests, and employee requests to inspect personnel records.
* Gather documents and information to support responses to agency charges (e.g., EEOC and state and local human rights agencies) and pending litigation.

Immigration & Work Authorization

* Partner with HR Operations/Talent Acquisition teams on Form I-9, E-Verify, and visa-related work authorization compliance processes.
* Monitor and track regulatory changes affecting visa holders.
* Track visa and work authorization expiration dates for employer-sponsored visas.
* Assist with self-audits for I-9/visa paperwork.
* Coordinate I-9/visa training with immigration counsel and internal stakeholders.

**Compensation**

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. In addition to a competitive base salary, you will be eligible to receive discretionary bonus incentives and a comprehensive benefits package.

Anticipated base salary range: $80,000 - $100,000

Actual base salary within the anticipated range will be determined by several components including, but not limited to, the individual's experience, skills, qualifications, and market factors.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 1-3 years of relevant experience in HR, Compliance, or a related field involving a similar skill set.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities and shift direction easily.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to draft clear, accurate memos, notices, and correspondence.
* Strong interpersonal skills with ability to work across all levels within the organization.
* Professional, diplomatic, and comfortable handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Self-starter, resourceful, and able to work independently and collaboratively.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel; experience with an HRIS (e.g., UKG) a plus.
* Comfort using generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to draft, research, and streamline work, paired with the judgment to verify outputs.
* Familiarity with multi-state employment law, background check requirements, severance agreements, or immigration compliance a plus.

Formed in 1972, Related is the most prominent privately owned real estate firm in the United States. Headquartered in New York City, the company has offices and major developments across the world. Related owns and manages a premier portfolio of assets valued at over $100 billion, including the 28-acre Hudson Yards neighborhood on Manhattan’s West Side.

new_jobs.description:
Cataloging/Metadata Analyst

**Required Qualifications (as evidenced by an attached resume):**  
Master’s degree (foreign equivalent or higher). Three (3) years of full-time relevant professional experience. Experience in metadata creation, original cataloging, metadata management, or related content services work in an academic library, research library, archives, or comparable cultural heritage organization. Experience working with library/archives management systems, digital repository platforms, or related technologies.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  
Experience with Alma (Library Management System) and OCLC Connexion. Knowledge of archival/library standards including DACS, EAD, MODS, MARC21, Dublin Core, authority control and controlled vocabularies. Demonstrated interest in leveraging emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI). Participation in/contributions to the cataloging and metadata communities (national/international). Experience working with diverse formats and subject areas. Experience in creating authority records.  
  
**Brief Description of Duties:**  
The Cataloging/Metadata Analyst supports the acquisition, description, discovery, preservation, and accessibility of the Libraries' rare books, manuscripts, and other distinctive collections. Reporting to the Director of Special Collections and University Archives, the position contributes to archival processing, cataloging, metadata creation, public services, and departmental operations. Through high-quality archival practices and user-centered services, the Cataloging/Metadata Analyst enhances the discovery, preservation, and use of Special Collections materials.  
  
The incumbent must demonstrate the ability to learn new technologies, adapt to evolving archival and metadata standards, and work effectively in a collaborative environment with researchers, students, faculty, staff, and community members.

* Cataloging, Metadata & Archival Description:

  + Create, edit, and maintain original and enhanced catalog records (original and copy cataloging plus related authority work), archival descriptions, and metadata for rare books, manuscripts, university archives, audiovisual materials, photographs, maps, and digital collections.
  + Apply national and international cataloging, metadata, and archival description standards to ensure accurate discovery, long-term preservation, and access. Utilize AI-assisted tools, when appropriate, to enhance metadata creation, description, quality assurance, and workflow efficiency while ensuring professional review and adherence to archival/library standards.
* Archival Processing, Collections Management & Preservation

  + Arrange, describe, preserve, and rehouse archival collections in accordance with archival best practices. Prepare, maintain, and update finding aids to support collection discovery and accessibility. Perform the physical retrieval, transport, shelving, and re-shelving of archival and special collections materials. Collaborate with library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, interlibrary loan, and collection access initiatives to support the stewardship and accessibility of collections.
* Reference, Research & Public Services

  + Provide reference and research assistance to faculty, students, university administrators, community members, and visiting scholars through in-person, virtual, telephone, and email communications, including the identification, retrieval, and interpretation of archival and special collections materials. Supervise Special Collections reading rooms.
* Outreach, Instruction & Collection Engagement

  + Support public programming that promotes awareness and use of Special Collections and University Archives including participation in exhibitions, tours, class visits, instructional sessions, and community outreach activities.
* Student/Intern Supervision & Departmental Operations

  + Recruitment, training, supervision and evaluation of student assistants and interns; departmental operational support. Collaboration with other library departments on cataloging/metadata, preservation, digitization, ILL and collection-access initiatives; participation in cross-departmental collection projects.
* Assessment, Professional Development & Service

  + Collect and analyze departmental data for contribution to strategic planning, assessment, reporting, and documentation that supports departmental priorities and continuous improvement.
* Other duties or projects as assigned as appropriate to rank and department mission.

**Special Notes:**  
This is a full-time appointment. FLSA Exempt position, not eligible for the overtime provisions of the FLSA. Minimum salary threshold must be met to maintain FLSA exemption.  
  
In addition to the employee's base salary, this position is eligible for $4,000 UUP annual location pay, paid biweekly.  
  
For this position, we are unable to sponsor candidates for work visas.

* Ability to gather requirements and translate business needs into system solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience documenting business processes and procedures.

* Experience with Jack Henry solutions including SilverLake, Xperience, jXchange, Enterprise Workflow, Banno, or related applications.
